title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: exporting an empty report downloads nothing and warns
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} has open bills only at {Location-B}.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-25 Elsewhere.
  • Starting screen: A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report") is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with only {Location-A} ticked in the Location filter.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Vendor filter, tick {Vendor-A}.
  2. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the report shows no rows: {Vendor-A} has nothing open at {Location-A}.
  • Step 2: the warning "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results" shows and nothing is downloaded (no new file in the browser's downloads).
  • Step 3: the same warning shows and nothing is downloaded.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S3-R10: “A successful export shows the native "Success" message, "Data exported successfully." An export with no rows downloads nothing and shows the native warning "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results".”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Export with no rows | "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results" | Warning toast; nothing downloads”
  • S5-E1: “If a location is chosen and the user then picks a customer or vendor with nothing open there, the report is empty and the Location chip stays visible so the selection can be cleared.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 2 "Export" (board Export.dc.html); page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). The design draws no picture of this behaviour (all 7 boards and 45 figures checked); the case follows the PRD.
